summary: Fixed four long-video shot bugs that made Studio drop close shots on money, big words and flying notes, adopted a rule that nobody on screen acts as a financial adviser, and started one Shorts experiment on the loop seam (loop-picture-matches-hook).
why: Two high-priority Scout adopt items (L-20261023-01 failed the layout probe on 30+ texts) plus two related ones, and a high-confidence research adopt item tied to YouTube's monetization policy. All four running experiments still wait for data; one experiment slot (5 max) was free and the ending area unused.

findings.title: 22 Shorts have 48 h data
findings.detail: quiet-bed 1 of 4 long per arm, hook-voice-matches-frame 1 of 8, title-names-the-moment 0 of 8, chart-gap-fill 0 of 4: all wait.

findings.title: Hook style
findings.detail: shock_number 1.14× median 48 h views (n=5, 38.1% viewed), question 0.74× (n=5), myth 0.34× (n=5, 24.9%).

findings.title: Voice
findings.detail: am_michael 1.00× with 49.3% viewed (n=6); videos without a narrator voice 0.34× (22.1%, n=5).

findings.title: Formats
findings.detail: Only rule_change has 3+ Shorts (n=3, 43.2% viewed): not under the median, so no format retired.

changes.title: Close shots on money keep the figure in frame
changes.detail: A shot on a stack frames its tag and label; a shot on a stack or phone zooms out just enough to keep it whole, also through the slow push (camera.ts keepInside, with tests). Test timeline: the targeted stacks' and phone's figures no longer leave the frame.

changes.title: Long phone readable
changes.detail: The phone is 360 px wide in long videos (was 280, lines ~25 px under the 30 px minimum); a label too long for its row ('Market, assumed' / '8%') goes above the value.

changes.title: Big word stays inside the frame
changes.detail: In long videos the drop-in word falls 50 px from inside the frame instead of 260 px from above it.

changes.title: Flying notes no longer fail the probe
changes.detail: The note's small currency sign is decoration (like Sikka's coin), not text to read.

changes.title: No adviser persona
changes.detail: Writer rule and fact-review reject reason: no line claims expertise or tells the viewer what to do with their money; descriptions say the characters are not advisers.

changes.title: Experiment: loop picture matches the hook
changes.detail: Half the Shorts end their last beat on the hook's set at a wide shot, so the replay seam is invisible. Judged on % viewed, 8 per arm.
